basic_info: 55-year-old male with chief complaint of right shoulder pain for a few weeks, starting after backyard work
present_illness: Onset after backyard work, pain localized to the outside of the shoulder, exacerbated by movement. The pain is more of a soreness, kinda like a dull ache, and it's mostly on the outside of the shoulder. It doesn't really radiate anywhere else, but it definitely hurts when I move it, especially when I raise my arm. The pain is aggravated when moving the arm, especially when raising it or lifting stuff, but it doesn't bother me when sitting still. I've been trying to ice it and take some Advil, which helps a little, but it's still sore to touch. No clicking, popping, or locking sensations in the shoulder when moving it. The pain is on the outside of my shoulder, kind of near the top where the arm connects, and it's been bothering me when I try to reach overhead or do any lifting. It doesn't really stop me from doing daily stuff, but it does make some things a bit uncomfortable, like putting on a shirt or reaching for something high. The movements that trigger the pain the most are raising my arm or doing any kind of lifting, especially with the projects I've been working on in the yard. I don't really have any weakness, but I do feel some limitation when I try to move it a certain way, though I can still move it pretty well overall. No numbness, tingling, or weakness in my arm or hand. Hand grip feels fine. No swelling, redness, or warmth around the affected shoulder area. No, I don't think I've had any recent trauma or fall to the shoulder that might have contributed to the pain. It started after I was doing a lot of work in the yard, but I don't remember specifically falling or hitting it. It just gradually started hurting after all the lifting and projects I've been doing. It does bother me a little at night because I sleep on that side, but it's not really keeping me up or disrupting my sleep too much. It's more of a mild discomfort that I notice when I shift positions.
past_history: Previous history of shoulder issues from playing baseball; no major injuries or surgeries reported.
